Product Details

Looking for a high tension cable that can withstand even the most extreme conditions? Look no further than the Polycab Etira 1.5 Sqmm 90m Blue Single Core FR Multistrand PVC Insulated Unsheathed Industrial Cable. This tough and durable cable is made with a special PVC compound that is resistant to fire, oil, abrasion, and chemicals, making it the perfect choice for even the most demanding applications. Looking for a reliable high tension cable? Look no further than the Polycab Unsheathed Industrial Cable. This tough and durable cable is made of flame retardant (FR) wire and is 90 m long. It has a voltage of 1100 V and a cross sectional area of 1.5 sqmm. The cable is blue in colour and is made of PVC insulated material.
